14. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING EXCEPT BICYCLES
ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
Lyon Street, east side, from 5 feet to 90 feet north of Fell Street
(85-foot bike share station) Pallavi Panyam, [staff email removed — see the order]
(Supervisor District 5)

Proposing to relocate an existing Bay Wheels bike share station to the parking lane on the east side of
Lyon Street. This station is being moved because of sewer work in the original location, scheduled to
complete in April.

Public Comments: No objections; questions about the environmental clearance citation and other
possible safety features; suggestions to improve the description for a temporary relocation of a bike
share station.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.

items.text:
15. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING EXCEPT BICYCLES
ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
Valencia Street, east side, from 81 feet to 141 feet north of 16th Street
(60-foot bike share station) Pallavi Panyam, [staff email removed — see the order]
(Supervisor District 6)

Formalizing the legislation of a Bay Wheels bike share station in the east side parking lane of Valencia
Street. The existing station was moved from its original location (east side of Valencia Street, just
north of 16th Street) to accommodate a shared space request at an adjacent business (Manny's).

Public Comments: No objections; questions about the environmental clearance citation; suggestions
to improve the description for a temporary relocation of a bike share station.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
